title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 13: Mshikamano wa kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the mbinu with the right term, proves each point with a line or event from "Sauti ya Mama Dunia", and says what it does in the work.

floor.prerequisite: Answers comprehension questions from a passage.
floor.question: Jibu linatoka wapi?

representations: the class shairi "Sauti ya Mama Dunia" with key pages marked
steps: Read the question and the term.
Find the part of the work.
Write the point with its evidence.
contexts: a school drama or poetry festival

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes one point with its evidence and its importance in the frame.

misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kama au mithili ya; sitiari hulinganisha moja kwa moja.
Eleza kazi ya mbinu: inajenga picha, inasisitiza, inaonyesha hisia.

misconceptions.ask: Je, jambo hili linaweza kuwa kweli?
misconceptions.repair: Lugha ya picha haina maana ya moja kwa moja.

misconceptions.ask: Kwa nini mwandishi amerudia neno hili?
misconceptions.repair: Takriri ni kurudia neno au kifungu ili kusisitiza.

checks.question: "Dunia ni mama analia" ni mbinu gani?
Mbinu ya tashihisi katika "Dunia ni mama analia" ina umuhimu gani?
checks.answer: inaipa dunia sifa za binadamu ili tuone uchungu wake
